description: This file contains unit tests for the Orleans streaming infrastructure, specifically testing checkpoint and recovery functionality of the EventHub stream provider after agent restarts or silo failures. It defines a test class with configuration setup, test methods, and helper functions for generating events and checking counters.

classes.name: EHStreamProviderCheckpointTests
classes.description: A test class for verifying checkpoint and recovery functionality of Orleans EventHub stream provider.

methods.name: ConfigureTestCluster
methods.description: Configures the test cluster with necessary storage and stream provider settings.

methods.name: ReloadFromCheckpointTest
methods.description: Test method for reloading stream state from checkpoint.

methods.name: RestartSiloAfterCheckpointTest
methods.description: Test method for restarting a silo after checkpoint and verifying recovery.

methods.name: ReloadFromCheckpointTestRunner
methods.description: Helper method that performs the actual reload from checkpoint and verifies counters.

methods.name: RestartSiloAfterCheckpointTestRunner
methods.description: Helper method that restarts a silo and verifies stream state recovery.

methods.name: CheckCounters
methods.description: Checks if the stream counters match expected values.
